integrity: The proof is symbolic: a residue-class summand-count obstruction gives the lower bound, and the inspected Fuller--Nichols theorem supplies the exact exponent-one endpoint. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result proves the exponent-one endpoint comparison for coprime arithmetic progressions whenever the higher-exponent threshold exists; it does not prove adjacent monotonicity for exponents at least two.
title: Exponent-one endpoint monotonicity for arithmetic-progression anti-Waring thresholds
